category_title: High-intensity students who rush through tasks and experience math anxiety
minimal_context: The student and tutor are working after school on a math assignment that requires calculating with decimals.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to work on calculating with decimals today. Let's set up this division problem.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I already wrote it down! I want to finish my homework in record time so I can go play sports.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at the steps. I will tell you which number goes in the division house.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moving with definite inner intensity) I'm just going to divide it this way so I can be done fast.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No, you need to follow the procedure. Put the other number inside.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: That is not what my teacher told me! I hate this, math is like a scary movie!
